turns.assessment: The outage is a hard all-channel optical loss at the launch of OMS S19->S06. Both input and output power are lost even at the booster, while incoming channel monitors at S19 show no change and amplifier pump currents remain normal; this localizes the break to the patch between the S19 ROADM and the booster, not a downstream span or amplifier. Recent maintenance at S19 further supports a disconnected patch cord.

proposals.rationale: E27 is the OMS S19->S06 input patch. Loss at the booster input propagates through every downstream amplifier and receiver, exactly matching the observations. Normal pump currents and unchanged incoming signals at S19 exclude amplifier failure and upstream loss.
A failed S19 WSS port could remove light before the booster, but the broad all-channel pattern and recent site maintenance favor the physical OMS input patch.
The same patch could be contaminated, but complete signal loss across all channels is much more consistent with a pulled or broken connector than added loss.
